fullText:
Good morning. Here is your daily brief for Tuesday 9 June 2026.

Walthamstow: 14°C, overcast, high 18° / low 10°, 61% chance of rain (expected 1pm–4pm).

GBP/USD 1.336 · GBP/ILS 3.898.

🚀 Israeli tech
- Kaltura has acquired eSelf, an AI avatar startup founded by a creator of Snap's AI technology, in a deal valued at 27 million dollars to integrate generative AI into enterprise video and learning tools <https://techcrunch.com/2025/11/10/kaltura-acquires-eself-founded-by-creator-of-snaps-ai-in-27m-deal/>
- AIR, an Israel-based eVTOL startup, raised 23 million dollars to scale production of piloted and uncrewed cargo aircraft and expand into the US market <https://techcrunch.com/2025/07/30/air-secures-23m-to-boost-u-s-expansion-and-evtol-innovation/>
- Israeli company Dataloop AI has announced a collaboration with Qualcomm Technologies to accelerate AI model development for mobile, automotive, IoT and other computing devices powered by Snapdragon processors <https://nocamels.com/2024/10/israeli-us-firms-team-up-to-develop-ai-models-for-devices/>
- So what for you: As a GTM advisor working with Israeli tech expanding to UK and global markets, watch these acquisition patterns and strategic partnerships like Dataloop-Qualcomm as signals of how Israeli AI companies are scaling internationally beyond venture funding.

🇮🇱 Israeli politics
- Gadi Eisenkot challenged Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to a public debate, calling for him to stop "incitement videos" and meet face-to-face to answer public questions about his leadership <https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-898849>
- Italy is investigating National Security Minister Ben Gvir for alleged torture and kidnapping related to a Gaza flotilla video, with the probe underway for several weeks, though Gvir says he remains "undeterred" <https://www.timesofisrael.com/italy-investigating-ben-gvir-for-alleged-torture-kidnapping-over-gaza-flotilla-video/>
- Lebanon's President Aoun told Israel to pursue talks rather than war and said he will not meet Netanyahu until a deal is signed, conditioning any normalization on establishment of a Palestinian state <https://www.timesofisrael.com/lebanons-aoun-urges-israel-to-pursue-talks-not-war-says-he-wont-meet-netanyahu-until-deal-signed/>
- So what for you: Coalition instability and international legal pressure on Israeli ministers could affect visa access and reputation risk if you're advising Israeli tech founders on UK expansion.

📱 Tech news
- Microsoft disabled over 70 repositories on GitHub, including Azure-related tools like azure-functions-host, after security researchers discovered hackers had added credential-stealing malware to them <https://www.techmeme.com/260608/p61#a260608p61>
- Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas announced the company is targeting an IPO for 2028, regardless of how OpenAI and Anthropic's public offerings perform <https://www.techmeme.com/260609/p2#a260609p2>
- Apple overhauled the App Store with new subscription options for groups and businesses, retention messaging to reduce churn, and bundled in-app purchase reviews, signalling a shift toward enterprise monetisation strategies <https://www.techmeme.com/260608/p65#a260608p65>
- So what for you: As a GTM advisor working with SaaS companies, you'll want to track Apple's App Store subscription changes and Perplexity's IPO timeline, both of which could reshape how B2B software companies approach iOS distribution and investor appetite in 2027 to 2028.

📰 Hacker News top 3
- Eagle Computer: The rise and fall of an early PC clone <https://dfarq.homeip.net/eagle-computer-the-rise-and-fall-of-an-early-pc-clone/>
- Forever Young: how one molecule can lock plants in a youthful state.(2025) <https://omnia.sas.upenn.edu/story/biologist-scott-poethig-plants-never-age>
- Microsoft's open source tools were hacked to steal passwords of AI developers <https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/microsofts-open-source-tools-were-hacked-to-steal-passwords-of-ai-developers/>

Today's question: With Israeli tech founders increasingly pursuing US expansion through acquisition and strategic partnerships rather than pure venture funding, are you positioning your advisory work to help them navigate the UK market as a stepping stone, or are they viewing Britain as a secondary priority compared to American scale?
